skill.name: error-diagnostics-smart-debug
skill.description: Diagnoses software errors through structured triage, ranked hypotheses, observability analysis, fix planning, validation, and prevention guidance.
skill.summary: Turn error reports and telemetry into evidence-based debugging plans.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax or ordinary checklist text in SKILL.md. The skill contains no shell execution, network reconnaissance, or intent-level security issue.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks wrap an inline Markdown path to supporting documentation. They do not invoke a shell or execute a command.
The backticks delimit a TypeScript example about observability analysis. The example contains no shell invocation or Ruby backtick execution.
Lines 135-136 state testing and performance success criteria. They contain no host discovery, scanning, probing, or other network reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Complex failures create scattered evidence and uncertain fixes. This skill organizes errors, telemetry, hypotheses, fixes, validation, and prevention into one debugging workflow.
actual_capabilities: Parses reported errors, stack traces, reproduction steps, affected components, environments, and failure patterns.
Produces three to five ranked root cause hypotheses with evidence, probability, falsification criteria, and tests.
Recommends debugging strategies based on reproducibility, environment, traffic behavior, and available observability data.
Identifies useful breakpoint, logpoint, trace, and instrumentation locations across code paths and integration boundaries.
Structures fix proposals with impact, risk, test coverage, rollback, validation, and prevention steps.
Defines post-fix success criteria covering tests, performance, error rates, and edge cases.
limitations: Requires the user to provide accurate error details, code context, logs, traces, or metrics.
Does not independently access Sentry, DataDog, production systems, source repositories, or deployment platforms.
Cannot confirm a root cause without environment-specific testing and evidence.
Recommendations may require permissions and safeguards before production instrumentation or traffic changes.

use_cases.title: Debug Application Failures
use_cases.description: Turn a reproducible error and stack trace into ranked causes, targeted tests, and a validation plan.

use_cases.title: Investigate Production Incidents
use_cases.description: Correlate logs, traces, metrics, and deployments to isolate intermittent service failures.

use_cases.title: Review High-Risk Fixes
use_cases.description: Assess proposed fixes, rollout risks, test coverage, rollback steps, and prevention measures before release.

prompt_templates.title: Triage an Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this error and list the missing information needed for triage: [error and context].

prompt_templates.title: Rank Root Causes
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this stack trace. Provide three ranked hypotheses, supporting evidence, falsification criteria, and the next test for each: [stack trace].
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured diagnosis of a reproducible failure

prompt_templates.title: Compare Observability Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these successful and failed request traces. Identify divergence points and recommend targeted instrumentation: [observability data].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis across logs and traces

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a production-safe analysis and fix plan for this intermittent incident. Include rollout, rollback, validation, and prevention: [incident evidence].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced incident response with operational constraints

output_examples.input: Checkout requests time out for five percent of users during payment processing.
output: Issue summary: Five percent of production checkouts exceed five seconds during payment processing.
Leading hypothesis: Sequential payment-method queries cause an N+1 delay.
Next test: Compare query counts and spans between successful and failed checkouts.
Validation: Confirm lower latency, stable error rates, passing tests, and no new edge cases.

output_examples.input: A background worker fails intermittently after deployment, but logs show only timeout warnings.
output: Evidence gap: Correlation identifiers, dependency latency, deployment timing, and retry behavior are missing.
Investigation: Compare successful and failed traces, then instrument external calls and state changes.
Fix gate: Reproduce or falsify each hypothesis before changing production code.

best_practices: Provide complete error messages, timestamps, environments, reproduction steps, and recent deployment details.
Separate observations from assumptions, and require evidence plus falsification criteria for every hypothesis.
Use protected, sampled, and reversible instrumentation before making production changes.
anti_patterns: Do not choose a root cause from an error message without checking logs, traces, code, and timing.
Do not enable broad production logging that may expose sensitive data or create excessive load.
Do not deploy a fix without regression tests, monitoring, rollback steps, and measurable success criteria.

faq.question: Does this skill execute debugging commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides a workflow and recommendations. Execution depends on available tools, permissions, and user approval.

faq.question: Can it access my monitoring platforms?
faq.answer: No. Provide relevant logs, traces, metrics, or approved tool access before requesting platform-specific analysis.

faq.question: Does it guarantee the root cause?
faq.answer: No. It ranks hypotheses and tests them against evidence, but environment-specific validation remains necessary.

faq.question: Can I use it for production incidents?
faq.answer: Yes. Use protected instrumentation, limited sampling, staged rollout, monitoring, and a tested rollback plan.

faq.question: Which evidence should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide errors, stack traces, timestamps, reproduction steps, logs, traces, metrics, environment details, and recent changes.

faq.question: Does it generate code fixes?
faq.answer: It can propose changes and tests when sufficient code context exists. Review and validate every change before deployment.
